Summary: Mid-market product analytics player. Completed 4-week Hosted API trial (Jan 12–Feb 9). Now evaluating Dedicated for production rollout tied to new ‘Insights Chat’ feature. Team wants predictable latency and cost per session.

Hosted-trial observations (from telemetry + call notes):
- Workload mix: 65% doc-search/embedding lookups (retrieval+rerank), 25% chat-style summarization, 10% synchronous reranking endpoints.
- Traffic during trial: baseline 3–6 QPS; feature flag ramp spikes up to 18–22 QPS for 10–15 minute bursts during analytics scans.
- Concurrency: observed 95th-percentile concurrency ~48 sessions during peak bursts; steady-state concurrency ~12.
- Token profile (typical request): prompt tokens median 620, model-generation tokens median 40 — average total ~660 tokens per request. Embedding calls are smaller (~128 tokens).
- Latency sensitivity: product requires p95 < 300ms for reranking path; chat UX tolerates p95 up to 800ms for longer summaries. Business says: "Customer experience breaks if rerank >350ms p95."
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market unit economics — need guidance on batching/quantization to hit target CAC for product-led users.

Technical asks from Moonlark:
- Dedicated sizing: recommended baseline capacity to cover steady QPS with headroom for 2x peak spikes (they requested examples for 2x/4x autoscale scenarios). Want explicit GPU-count and expected QPS/concurrency mapping.
- Traffic forecasting: want a 6-month forecast model that incorporates product ramp, weekly scan jobs that create traffic spikes, and expected conversion from free trial to paid.
- Fallbacks/routing: need a policy for degraded capacity (fallback to smaller model or queue) with clear cost and latency tradeoffs.
- Security/ops: SSO + SCIM, KMS integration, audit log retention 1y, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-01-12: Hosted API onboarding, default prompts and templates pushed. (Drive: POC runbook)
- 2026-01-20: First load test — peak 12 QPS; flagged rerank latencies ~420ms p95 on hosted small model. (FF: ff-20260122-1182)
- 2026-02-02: Mid-POC sync — product team requested quantization recommendations; Redwood suggested optimize tier best practices.
- 2026-02-18: Demo w/ infra + product leadership — discussed Dedicated slot economics and fallbacks. (FF: ff-20260218-3245)
- 2026-02-25: Delivered preliminary traffic sample and token mix export; finance asked for ARR/line-item for Dedicated 2/4-slot scenarios.

Recommendations / SE notes (Priya Nair):
- Baseline Dedicated spec: 2x 80GB-class GPUs with autoscale to 4 for peak bursts (estimate handles steady 6 QPS with p95 < 250ms for rerank; autoscale to 4 to cover burst QPS 22 with p95 < 350ms).
- Batching & KV-cache: enable prefix KV caching for repeated retrieval prompts; set batching windows to 40ms for rerank paths to balance latency/cost.
- Quantization: test int8 variant for reranking path in staging — expect ~1.8x throughput improvement with ~2% quality delta.
- Forecast inputs requested from customer: 6-month growth %, weekly scan schedule, % of users that trigger multi-step chat flows, expected percent conversion to paid.

Quoted customer line: "We liked how Hosted got us running fast — now we need predictable cost and headroom for Q2 feature launch. Help us size it so we don't overcommit."

Next steps (short):
- Deliver final Dedicated sizing doc (by 2026-03-05) with explicit QPS->GPU mapping and cost delta for 2 vs 4 slot autoscale.
- Internal pricing run-through with Redwood finance (Jordan) week of 2026-03-08.
- Schedule 90-min Dedicated workshop with Moonlark infra/product (target 2026-03-12).
- Security team to provide KMS documentation and SOC2 evidence (Priya to attach).
